verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a work-management SaaS, but the evidence pack never documents a bulk or full-account export, open export formats, or an account-exit path. The GraphQL API and integrations are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a first-party export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
